author: utd6
content: Decision: the kernel-checked-vs-solver split keys on the 'kernel-checked' trust-string MARKER, not on engine name — the bv engine tag stays 'bitvector' whether or not the clause migrated, and nlsat-relax clauses are also kernel-grounded, so a name-based split would miscount. Decision: EPR-stratified rel/array (the G2 residual) is NAMED not migrated — the reconstruction fragment (QF_LIA + arith/cmp QF_BV) structurally excludes uninterpreted rel/array atoms; F-J makes that free. Decision: gate the ResidualTrust section on !bv_shadows.is_empty() so the v1/nlsat audit goldens stay byte-identical (the additive semantic_forks discipline).
